title: Choose the visual world
question: Choose a named direction to lock it, or re-roll again for a new set.

options.label: Photo-Finish Rail
options.lineage: finish-line slit photography and timing adjudication strips
options.thesis: Each image crosses one calibrated line; the evidence alongside it determines what the app can honestly call.
options.viewport: A single off-centre rail anchors the two workflow tabs, the live image, evidence ticks, and one large result plate without breaking into dashboard cards.
options.risk: The timing-strip metaphor must remain subordinate to plain upload and download language.

raised.raise: Every action uses friendly plain-language copy and a generous target.
Long evidence explanations keep a calm readable measure.
State is legible by line form as well as color.

options.label: Evidence Folder
options.lineage: photo-editor verification folders and annotated newsroom evidence
options.thesis: The app behaves like a careful picture desk: source on the left, claim and supporting notes on the right.
options.viewport: Two tabbed folder leaves hold a large image, a factual evidence column, and an explicit confidence stamp.
options.risk: The editorial evidence pattern is highly legible but more familiar than the timing-rail direction.

options.label: Warm Workbench
options.thesis: Two comfortable task surfaces use one action-only color and plain language from upload to result.
options.viewport: A thumb-friendly tab bar sits above one generous upload surface, followed by a readable result and a persistent action area.
options.case: It wins immediate familiarity but loses the assigned direction's visible evidence mechanism.
options.risk: Without strict information hierarchy it could look like any other browser utility.

options.label: Signal Lexicon
options.lineage: a nineteenth-century lexicon with bordered color plates
options.thesis: Every detected signal becomes a precise entry, while the image lives inside the only color plate on the page.
options.viewport: A dense but readable evidence column faces one bordered image plate with guide words tracking the current result range.
options.case: The evidence model is excellent, but the historical reading surface slows a quick one-step task.
options.kept: Evidence explanations receive editorial reading quality, not utility-caption treatment.
options.risk: It can make a modern privacy tool feel archival and slow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Two conventional tabs, a centered dropzone, a privacy line, and a result card.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar header, tab switcher, upload box, and blue primary action.
canonCard.risk: Immediately understandable, but interchangeable with other image utilities.
